title: team create: template registry leeg in projectworkspaces
description: Tijdens sprint 2 van project Eren Rent activeerde orchestrate.py team mode voor EREN-030 met template devops-team, maar team.py create faalde met: invalid choice: 'devops-team' (choose from ) — de choices-lijst is leeg. De team-templates worden blijkbaar niet gevonden/geseed in het .cto-workspace van het project. Fallback naar solo delegation werkte, maar team mode is de facto kapot in projecten buiten de orchestrator-repo.
proposed_changes: team.py laadt templates waarschijnlijk uit een relatief pad (references/team-templates) dat alleen in de orchestrator-repo bestaat; resolve het pad t.o.v. de skill/script-locatie of seed templates bij init_project.sh.

triage.evidence: scripts/team.py:124-125 `def _templates_dir(root): return root / "agents" / "templates"`; no __file__-based fallback anywhere in the file (grep for __file__/SCRIPT_DIR/parent.parent returns nothing in team.py). scripts/team.py:1058 `c.add_argument("--template", required=True, choices=list_templates(), ...)` — empty choices outside orchestrator repo. init_project.sh only mkdirs .cto/tickets, .cto/logs, .cto/decisions (lines 41-43); it never copies agents/templates. agents/templates/*.json (api-team, devops-team, fullstack-team, security-team) exist only in the orchestrator repo.
triage.note: Bug still present: team.py resolves templates from project root (root/agents/templates) via find_cto_root(), but agents/templates only exists in the orchestrator repo and init_project.sh never seeds it. In any external project workspace list_templates() returns [], so the argparse --template choices list is empty and team create always fails with the reported error. No fallback was added by recent evolve cycles. Fix is a small path-resolution change in scripts/team.py only; prometheus.py untouched.
